lines.text: Earthquakes can have a negative magnitude.
Magnitude minus one is real. Far too small for any person to feel.
Its energy? About half a gram of TNT.
Now climb. Every whole step is about thirty-two times the last.
Magnitude one, half a kilo. Magnitude three, about four hundred and eighty kilos. Magnitude five, about four hundred and eighty tonnes.
Magnitude seven, about four hundred and eighty kilotons. Magnitude nine, about four hundred and eighty megatons.
And nothing in the scale itself says stop. It has no upper limit.
So where does it actually stop? That's in the full video, linked right here.
